home.q: Do I need a G1 before lessons?
home.a: Yes. A valid G1 is required before in-car lessons, and students must be 16 or older.

home.q: What does the BDE course include?
home.a: 20 hours of online learning, 10 hours of home-link and 10 hours of private in-car training.

home.q: Do you pick up and drop off?
home.a: Yes, from home, school or work in London, St. Thomas, Thorndale and Dorchester.

home.q: What if I need to cancel?
home.a: Please give at least 24 hours notice to reschedule. Late cancellations and no-shows are charged $50. Cancel within 15 days of registering for a 50% refund; after that, packages are non-refundable.
Absolutely. Our patient, supportive approach helps every student build confidence.
